description: Check a form's markup against the style rules in Luke Wroblewski's Web Form Design. Pass a public `url` (fetched safely, public hosts only) or pasted `html`. Reports findings with severity (high, medium, low, info) and a fix for label association and placement, placeholder used as a label, required and optional marking, number of fields, input types and autocomplete tokens, inline validation hooks (native constraints, aria-describedby, aria-invalid), vague or risky buttons (Submit, Reset, disabled submit), and ungrouped radio, checkbox and payment fields. Where a check is a common convention and not his stated rule, the finding says so. Reads static markup only: it cannot see CSS, so top versus left label alignment is not confirmed, and script-built fields are invisible. For WCAG-referenced form findings and error message linting, use audit_form.

html.description: Form or page HTML. Use this or url.
